what: Narrative species pages, vendored. The markdown here is the published artifact.
notes: Only the markdown is vendored. The per-page JSON (prompts, model answers, source clusters, independence maths) stays in the private draft repo; this repo carries exactly what publishes.
Each page states its own evidence basis, its own gaps, and its own 'generated ... model sonnet' provenance footer. Do not strip those when rendering.

U+26A0 means danger and nothing else: it appears on exactly the 195 pages that carry a danger level (28 deadly, 80 poisonous, 87 caution). Verified set-equal at vendoring time. Do not reuse the glyph for any other meaning anywhere in this repo.
Template pages for the long tail are NOT here. They are regenerated into template-pages/ by scripts/render-template-pages.mjs during prebuild and are gitignored.
